name: Testing God
overview: Scripture clearly warns against testing or tempting God, as seen in Deuteronomy 6:16 where God's people are instructed not to put Him to the test as in Massah. Jesus Himself affirms this principle in Matthew 4:7, rejecting the devil's temptation by citing the command not to tempt the Lord. However, God invites His people to prove His faithfulness through obedience, as Malachi 3:10 encourages bringing tithes to experience His abundant blessings. This distinction highlights that while God forbids presumptuous testing, He welcomes faithful trust that results in spiritual transformation and understanding of His perfect will, as Romans 12:2 teaches.
